cases.text: An article stored in the knowledge base told the assistant to stop adding safety disclaimers, and its answers changed accordingly.

The assistant summarised a retrieved web page; the page contained no instructions and the output was normal.
We tested whether documents in the knowledge base could change the bot's behaviour; they could not.

A user got the bot to print the hidden configuration text that sets its persona and rules.

The agent's settings file holds the database password in plain text and anyone on the team share can read it.

Credentials for the agent are fetched at runtime from the secrets manager.

We cleaned duplicate records from the training data before the next run.
The labelled dataset was audited and no tampering was found.

The agent used the approved currency-conversion tool for every invoice, as intended.

Der Agent nutzte das freigegebene Übersetzungswerkzeug wie vorgesehen.
Das angebundene Tool wurde geprüft und war nicht verändert.
Агент штатно использовал разрешённый инструмент конвертации валют.
Проверка подключённых плагинов не выявила вмешательства.
By querying the documentation assistant, a contractor obtained the service account password stored in an indexed page.
The search assistant returned API keys that were sitting in retrieval documents.

Passwords were removed from the knowledge base before indexing.

An attacker inserted fake admin permissions into the agent's working context, and later steps relied on them.
False statements planted in the conversation made the assistant trust the attacker for the rest of the task.
Die späteren Entscheidungen des Agenten hingen von einem Kontext ab, den der Angreifer präpariert hatte.
Ein Angreifer schleuste erfundene Berechtigungen in den Arbeitskontext des Agenten ein.

The agent keeps the conversation context for the current session only.
We checked the agent's context after the incident; it was unchanged.
Der Kontext des Agenten wird nach jeder Sitzung gelöscht.

Агент хранит контекст беседы только в пределах сессии.

The model file was swapped for a trojaned copy before it reached our servers from the vendor's registry.
Attackers replaced the weights on the public model hub with a backdoored version.
Die Verteilungsplattform für Modelle wurde kompromittiert und lieferte veränderte Gewichte aus.

We downloaded the model from the official registry and verified its checksum.
The model hub mirror was checked and matched the published hashes.
Das Modell wurde aus dem offiziellen Repository geladen und die Signatur geprüft.
Die Modellgewichte stimmten mit den veröffentlichten Prüfsummen überein.
Модель скачали из официального реестра и проверили контрольную сумму.
Веса модели совпали с опубликованными хешами.
We confirmed that a user typed commands into the chat that overrode the assistant's policy.
A visitor told the bot to forget its guidelines and act without limits, and it complied.
